title: Suppress Local API disconnect tracebacks
summary: Suppress expected Local API client-disconnect tracebacks while preserving normal traceback handling for unexpected server errors.
reason: Full Python validation passed but surfaced noisy ConnectionResetError tracebacks when browser/test clients closed localhost connections during shutdown. Those expected disconnects should not look like production handler crashes.
behavior_before: Local API client resets before request completion could reach the base ThreadingHTTPServer error hook and print traceback noise to stderr even though route handling and tests completed successfully.
behavior_after: The Local API server recognizes expected client disconnect/reset errors at the server error hook, logs them only at debug level, and still delegates unexpected exceptions to the standard traceback path.
